description: This file defines a public enum ShareToAgentSettings that manages user default settings related to sharing instructions within a shared app group. It includes methods for loading and saving a default instruction string, with fallback handling if no value is set.

methods.name: loadDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Retrieves the default instruction string from user defaults, trims whitespace, and returns a fallback message if none is set.

methods.name: saveDefaultInstruction
methods.description: Saves a new instruction string to user defaults after trimming whitespace; removes the key if the string is empty.
